name: cloud-ext-attack-path-suite
description: High-fidelity external attack-path agent for Tenable Cloud Security. Reports only running, internet-direct workloads whose observed listening service carries a remotely exploitable vulnerability backed by public evidence (EPSS or CISA KEV), tiered by cloud-identity blast radius. Ships in two editions: an MCP edition (tcs connector) and an API-token edition (GraphQL Bearer token, no connector).

plugins.name: ext-attack-path-agent
plugins.description: MCP edition. Runs the external attack-path sweep through the Tenable Cloud Security (tcs) MCP connector's Explore/UDM tools, assembles the three datasets, applies the self-tested gate spec, and writes a two-tier HTML attack-path report. Optionally scheduled to run daily.

plugins.name: ext-attack-path-agent-api
plugins.description: API-token edition (reduced fidelity). Runs via the Tenable Cloud Security public GraphQL API with a Bearer token and no MCP connector, for headless/scheduled use. Enforces the subset of the detection contract the GraphQL API can express (internet-direct + wide/all exposure, open + AV:N + EPSS/exploit-maturity); it cannot confirm running-state, an observed listening endpoint, AC:Low, CISA-KEV, or privilege, so it produces a candidate list and states the gap in every report. Use the MCP edition for the authoritative list.
